question: The largest whole number such that seven times the number is less than \(100\) is
solution:
We need the last whole number whose multiple of 7 is below 100. Since
\[
7\cdot14=98<100,
\qquad 7\cdot15=105>100,
\]
14 works and 15 does not. Every larger whole number has an even larger multiple of 7. Thus the largest possible number is \(\boxed{14}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
